series_short_description: Growing up in Virginia Beach as autistic fraternal twins, Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie build an unbreakable sibling sanctuary to weather school heartbreaks, family storms, and the Blizzard of '96.
series_description: Katie & Nathaniel follows the childhood and teenage years of autistic fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie in Virginia Beach. From secret afternoon cartoon passwords, summer camp at Virginia Dominion University alongside Michael and Rachel Ragsdale, and holiday sofa-bed sanctuaries to the historic Blizzard of '96 and middle-school Spirit Week, Nate and Katie discover that while the outside world—and their mother's alcoholism—can be loud and unforgiving, twin brothers and sisters never leave each other behind.
